title: Cinematic Xianxia Delivery Mission Narrative Film
description: A complex continuous multi-shot narrative cinematic video prompt combining xianxia swordmaster protection elements with a modern everyday delivery setting under heavy rain storm, leveraging Seedance 2.0 capabilities.
promptText:
I. Task Objective

Generate a complete and continuous 15-second cinematic-grade realistic short film.

Overall Setting:

High-tension Xianxia 'escort mission' choreography colliding with an extremely mundane modern food delivery scene.

Core Aesthetic:

Cinematic realistic quality
Cold blue rainstorm ambient light forms a distinct contrast with warm city real-scene lights
Wet ground reflections, controlled volumetric rain curtains, real physical effects
Restrained deadpan comedy
Characters do not rely on making fools of themselves to create humor
Treat small things in modern life as genuine heroic chivalric tasks that must be accomplished

Key Focus to Leverage Seedance 2.0 Capabilities:

15-second multi-shot continuous output
Multimodal reference consistency
Stable movement of complex dual subjects
Native audio-visual synchronization
Stable continuity of props and space

II. Character Identity Locking

Character ID A | @Image 1 | Sword Immortal Sister

Consistently maintain the same character:

25–30 year old East Asian female
Same face
Sharp dark eyes
Black long straight hair
Tall and slender build
Jade hairpin
White embroidered silk Hanfu
Semi-transparent layered wide sleeves
Silver waist ornaments
White cloth boots
Same silver long sword
Character Disposition:

Extremely serious
Calm and restrained
Truly treats the escort mission as a major affair in the martial arts world

Character ID B | @Image 2 | Bicycle Sister

Consistently maintain the same character:

25–30 year old East Asian female
Same face
Brown ponytail
Fixed body proportions
Yellow jacket
Blue jeans
White sneakers
Fixed accessories
Same bicycle
Vehicle & Props:

A rigid insulated delivery box is firmly fixed on the rear rack of the bicycle
Inside the delivery box is only a single tall and fragile cream cake
The cake must remain stable and continuous throughout
The cream surface of the cake must not collapse, get wet, or tilt

III. Scene & General Continuity

The entire film takes place only at the same real-city location in a rainstorm, no location switching.

Environmental Requirements:

Heavy rainstorm continues fiercely
Cold blue rainy night ambient light
Warm city lights as local supplements
Wet ground, puddles, reflections, roadside lights, building eaves, and realistic city paths must uniformly exist
The rain curtain has a sense of volume and density layering
Ground reflections change in real-time with characters, bicycles, lights, and rainwater
Real water splashes occur when wheels pass through puddles
The background is always alive but does not actively drive the plot
The environment only provides realistic physical feedback:
Rain continues to fall
Wind affects hair, garment hems, cuffs, and rain line directions
Wheels pressing over wet ground bring out water splashes
Light mapping on wet ground and vehicle bodies continuously changes

IV. Three-Shot Structure
Shot 1 | 0–5s

Framing & Camera Position
Low-angle full shot, slow tracking, 24fps, cinematic camera movement is stable with a sense of weight
Screen Content
Heavy rain fiercely washes over the same city background location. The same Bicycle Sister stands beside the bicycle, checking the same delivery box. The same Sword Immortal Sister stands aside, keeping calm and alert. Inside the delivery box is only the same tall and fragile cream cake.
Performance & Dialogue
Bicycle Sister quickly says: 'Three minutes, cannot get wet, cannot tilt.'
The same Sword Immortal Sister immediately draws out the same silver long sword, only replying: 'I will escort.'
Detail Requirements
Bicycle Sister's movements are swift like an experienced delivery rider. Sword Immortal Sister's movements are clean, decisive, and serious. Heavy rain, wind, hair, wide sleeves, jacket hems all naturally react to forces. Warm city lights form realistically elongated reflections on the wet ground. This shot must let the audience immediately understand the mission goal: protect the cake.

Shot 2 | 5–10s
Framing & Camera Position
Cowboy shot to medium shot, side stable tracking shot, maintaining continuity with the bicycle's forward direction
Screen Content
The same Bicycle Sister rides rapidly in the same rainstorm. The same Sword Immortal Sister wearing a white embroidered silk Hanfu steps on the same silver long sword, gliding side-by-side to escort. Sword Immortal Sister simultaneously releases six small sword shadows; they consistently rotate at high speed around the bicycle, forming a moving protective formation.
Protective Formation Rules
The six sword shadows are small in volume and precisely controlled. Their function is explicit: only responsible for cutting through the heavy rain above the bicycle and the delivery box. The rain curtain is split to both sides, forming a narrow but stable dry channel above the bicycle and the cake. No exaggerated light pollution, no huge special effects. The existence of the sword shadows should feel like a practical application of high-level sword control technique.
Continuity Requirements
The cake position is consistent with the previous shot. The bicycle movement direction is continuous with the previous shot. The spatial relationship of the city background is continuous. Character clothing, hairstyles, and props are absolutely stable.
Physics & Audio
Car lights form fluid reflections on the wet ground. Wheel splashing is realistic. Long hair, silk wide sleeves, jackets, and pants cuffs are all affected by wind and speed. Sword hums, bicycle chain rhythms, rain sounds, and thunder maintain precise synchronization. The movement speeds of the two people are coordinated, no floating, not gliding like game characters.

Shot 3 | 10–15s
Framing & Camera Position
Close-up entering extreme close-up, camera stably approaches character and prop reactions. The rhythm retains a short quiet pause after stopping.
Screen Content
The two rush into a sheltered area and stop. The same Bicycle Sister immediately opens the same delivery box. The cake inside remains perfectly upright and stable, the cream surface completely dry, not wet, not tilted. She clearly breathes a sigh of relief, then looks up only to find: the same Sword Immortal Sister is completely soaked from head to toe. The reason must be clearly readable: just now all flying swords consistently only protected the delivery box, she didn't block even a single drop of rain for herself.
Dialogue & Reaction
Bicycle Sister freezes, asking: 'Why didn't you block it for yourself?'
A half-second pause on scene. Sword Immortal Sister wipes away the rain from her eyebrows, answering with an absolutely serious tone: 'Mission priority.'
Bicycle Sister remains silent for two seconds, handing her an incredibly tiny tissue from her pocket.
In the extreme close-up: Sword Immortal Sister first looks down at the tissue, then looks up at Bicycle Sister, still maintaining a cold expression, and finally accepts it silently. This moment forms the comedy resolution of the entire film.

V. Performance Principles

Sword Immortal Sister
Deadpan serious throughout. Cannot intentionally act cute. No self-deprecation. She truly treats protecting the cake as a high-spec mission.
Bicycle Sister
Realistic, swift, professional. Slight bewilderment and speechlessness come from genuine reactions. The sense of comedy comes from her natural contrast when facing the 'overly serious warrior logic.'
Comedy Principle
The laugh point can only come from: the mission goal is too ordinary; Sword Immortal Sister's way of handling the task is too solemn; she gave all protective resources to the cake; the final tiny tissue forms a mild closure.

VI. Uniform Technical Requirements
Strict total duration of 15 seconds. 16:9 widescreen, 24fps. Three clean shots. Continuously completed at the same location. Character identities are stable, clothing is stable, bicycle is stable, cake is stable, long sword is stable, the number of six sword shadows is stable. Mandarin lip-sync is accurate. Native synchronous generation of stereo rain sounds, thunder, wheel splashing, chain sounds, sword hums, and dialogue. No onscreen subtitles are generated.

VII. Strict Avoidance
blurry, bad quality, low quality, low resolution, noisy, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, error, deformed, mutated, bad anatomy, poorly drawn hands, bad composition, out of frame, disfigured, inconsistent character, changing clothes, face morphing, background shift, glitching cuts, disappearing props.
Additional Prohibitions: Location switching, AI morph transitions, cake suddenly changing size, delivery box disappearing, bicycle structural changes, flying sword count changing randomly, overly strong fantasy light pollution, characters floating/gliding, rain curtain looking like a 2D texture, wet ground reflections freezing, overacted comedy, exaggerated distorted expressions.

VIII. Final Effect Goal
The entire film must feel like a genuinely shot short movie: escorting a cake in a rainstorm looks visually like a Xianxia mission and emotionally like serious business, finally landing on an extremely light deadpan laugh point.
Final Perception Keywords: Xianxia escort, rainstorm night walk, over-seriousness, cake priority, deadpan humor, cinematic realism.

title: 1984 Showa Era Home Video
description: This prompt recreates a nostalgic 1980s home video aesthetic, showing a group of children playing in a Japanese housing complex park with realistic period details.
promptText:
[Overview] Until evening with an 8-year-old boy playing 'kick the can' in a housing complex park in 1984. A father records from a distance without speaking using a newly bought home video camera. 480p, 16:9, 15 seconds. 7 shots (approx. 2s each) of hard cuts, all in different locations. No transitions or fades. The subject does nothing toward the camera: no eye contact, no showing objects, no waving, no posing. Immersed in play. Fragments of daily life, not acting. No conversation, dialogue, or narration at all.

[Subject] Definition of Beauty: A Japanese boy cute enough to be cast as a child actor. The face immersed in play is best. Face: Short cropped black hair, thick straight eyebrows, clear double-lidded large eyes, sun-tanned skin (realistic texture), a bandage on the tip of the nose, one front tooth growing in with a gap. Clothing (everyday wear): White tank top (slightly stretched neck), blue shorts, white rubber-soled sneakers (dirty toes), a tenugui towel around the neck. Habit: Swings arms wide when running, doesn't stop even if nearly tripping. Face, hair, and clothing are completely identical in all shots.

[Characters] 3 Playmates: A girl with a bob cut and red skirt, a slightly chubby boy with a baseball cap, a thin boy with black-rimmed glasses. All tanned, wearing sneakers. No one looks at the camera. Mother: Standing small in the distance on a balcony in the 7th shot (face indistinguishable).

[Era, Place, Light] Housing complex in the summer of 1984. 1. Exterior stairs of the complex (afternoon white light) 2. Beside the park's sandbox (Kick the can: game where the 'it' guards a can on the ground while hidden kids run to kick it. Can is plain silver with no text) 3. Inside a concrete pipe in the park 4. Top of the jungle gym (blue sky) 5. Park water fountain (light in the splashing water) 6. Shade under the water tower 7. Sunset road in the complex (long orange shadows). No signs or text on screen.

[Camera] 1984 home video camera texture: bleeding colors, low resolution, blown-out bright skies, soft outlines. No date display. Shoulder-mounted handheld, natural shake, imperfect composition, zoom hunting, exposure fluctuations. Distance of 3–6m from subject. Subject ignores camera. No stabilization, gimbal, drone, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading. Camera is always at the filmer's eye level (standing, sitting, crouching, walking). No impossible angles (air, water, ceiling, etc.). As a person present, the filmer follows movement with a slight delay and composition is sometimes loose.

[Shots] (Approx. 2s each. Each line = Location/Light / Activity / Inner emotion & small leaking gesture / Camera position)
1. Complex stairs, afternoon. Running down skipping steps, nearly tripping on the last one, continues running. Emotion: Wants to play quickly. Only looking forward. Camera: Looking up from bottom of stairs.
2. Beside the sandbox. Placing the can on the ground, fixing it with a foot, covering eyes with both hands. Emotion: Serious about being 'it.' Mouth shut. Friends scatter. Camera: From the side, children running in background.
3. Inside the pipe. Half showing face from darkness, holding breath, moving only eyes. Emotion: Thrilled about nearly being found. Camera: Peering in from outside the pipe.
4. Top of jungle gym, blue sky. Standing at the top, pointing at a distant friend. Emotion: Triumphant. Chest out, mouth wide open (no sound). Camera: Looking up, sky blown out.
5. Water fountain. Turning faucet up to douse head, shaking head like a dog. Emotion: Feels good. Smiling with eyes closed. Camera: Father steps closer, water splashes the lens, a small laugh escapes him.
6. Shade under the water tower. Sitting with friends, staring at a scrape on the knee, poking it with a finger. Emotion: Tired and satisfied. Shoulders slumped. Camera: From the side, slightly distant.
7. Sunset complex road. Noticing mother on the distant balcony, reluctantly starts running. Silhouette disappears into the shadow of the complex entrance. Emotion: Doesn't want to go home but does. Camera: Standing in the middle of the road, watching the receding back. Around 00:14, the recording suddenly cuts to a blackout. No fade out.

[Item Details] Can is plain silver and dented. Sneakers have soil-blackened toes. Tenugui is white with indigo patterns. Bandage is skin-colored. Water fountain is a square concrete block with a metal faucet. Pipe is grey concrete with no graffiti inside.

[Text Prohibition] No readable text, logos, signs, labels, or numbers. Can is plain.

[Physics/Consistency] Real-world physics. No extra fingers, fused hands, distorted anatomy. Feet grounded. Bandage, tank top, and friends' clothes are same in all shots.

[Sound] Natural ambient sounds only: cicadas, footsteps on stairs, sound of the can, distant children's voices (laughter/footsteps, not readable words), water fountain sound, wind at water tower, evening crows. No words at all. Occasional small laughs/breathing from filmer and subject allowed. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

[Atmosphere] A record of a mundane day for a child in a Showa-era housing complex that makes adults think 'there was an evening like this.' Not acting, but fragments of immersive play. Nostalgic, bright, and deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.

title: DV Tape Camcorder Gym Vlog
description: A 30-second multi-cut gym vlog script sequence featuring a Korean idol exercising, framed in an early 2000s handheld DV camcorder aesthetic.
promptText:
30s Gym Vlog — 9 Cuts

CAMERA/LOOK: DV 16mm tape camcorder, handheld POV by CHASE or propped on gym equipment for lifts. Shaky framing, delayed focus, clumsy zooms, occasional face cutoffs. Soft blurry tape texture, faint noise, bloomed gym lights, flickering exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin.

STYLE: Focused, upbeat, authentic gym-vlog energy. CHASE talks through her progress between sets, showing genuine effort and small wins.

CHASE: Korean idol in her 20s, long black high ponytail, expressive eyes, slim athletic build, light sweat. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, joggers/leggings, sneakers, towel around neck, no jewelry.

SETTING: Evening gym with bench press, shoulder press machine, dip station, mirrors, water bottle, soft overhead lighting.

STORYBOARD:

1. Bench setup (~3s): Propped medium shot. She adjusts grip and looks at camera. “Okay, push day — starting with bench press.”
2. Bench reps (~3.5s): Side angle, controlled reps, racks bar. “That’s ten — felt stronger than last week, honestly.”
3. Walk (~2.5s): Handheld as she grabs towel/water and heads to shoulder press. “Alright, shoulders next.”

Items: A plain pink can (no text or logo printed) with a pink straw. Habit: Twirling one of the twin tails around her finger, stretching sleeves to half-hide hands. [Characters] Best Friend (Filmer): Not visible on screen, but occasional small laughs, breathing, and the sound of clothes rubbing as the camera is adjusted are heard (no words). In the 5th shot, only the friend's knees and black skirt enter the frame.

[Era, Place, Light] Modern summer. 1. Own bed (light through curtains before noon) 2. Entrance hall step (dim warm colors) 3. Park bench (sunlight through trees at noon) 4. Riverside promenade (afternoon white light) 5. Friend's room floor (evening window light) 6. Night footbridge (streetlights and car lights below) 7. Train window seat on the way back (interior lighting, dark outside). Choose locations and angles where signs, text, logos, or screens do not enter the frame. No reflections in window glass.

[Camera] Horizontal handheld video from a modern smartphone. Natural camera shake, imperfect composition, occasional autofocus hunting, exposure fluctuations, light motion blur. Maintain a distance of 2–4m from the subject, zooming in only to hands or profile. The subject ignores the camera. No stabilization, gimbal, drone, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading. The camera is always shot from the position the filmer is holding it (standing, sitting, crouching, walking, or from the next seat). Do not use angles from places a person cannot be (air, water, ceiling, directly above, inside a moving car from outside, a few centimeters in front of the subject, etc.). As a person physically present in the same space, the filmer follows the subject with a slight delay when she moves, and the composition occasionally becomes loose. No mirror or glass reflections.

[Shots] (Approx. 2s each. Each line = Location/Light / Activity / Inner emotion & small leaking gesture / Camera position)
1. Own bed, before noon. Lying down, fixing bangs with a finger. Emotion: Doesn't want to wake up. Heavy eyelids, a sigh escapes. Camera: From the foot of the bed.
2. Entrance hall step. Hand fastening the belt of platform shoes. Emotion: Gearing up to go out. Lips pursed while pulling the belt. Camera: From diagonally above toward the hands.
3. Park bench, sunlight through trees. Looking at the sky while slowly sipping from a pink straw in a plain pink can. Emotion: Languid release. Eyes half-closed. Camera: From the side, slightly distant.
4. Riverside promenade, afternoon. Looking at the distant water surface while twirling a twin tail. Emotion: A bit lonely. Corners of the mouth down, only the finger continues moving. Camera: From behind diagonally.
5. Friend's room floor, evening. Closing eyes with head on friend's lap. Emotion: Relief. Brows open, mouth relaxes. Camera: Floor height, close proximity.
6. Night footbridge. Resting chin on the railing, looking at car lights flowing below. Emotion: Vague satisfaction. Slow blinking. Camera: From the side, streetlights.
7. Train window seat on the way back. Leaning head against the window with eyes closed, twin tail draped over the shoulder. Emotion: Fulfilled sleepiness. Outside is dark, no reflections. Camera: From the next seat, dark outside. Around 00:14, the recording suddenly cuts to a blackout. No fade out.

[Item Details] Pink can is plain with no text or logo, sweating with water droplets. Pink straw is slightly crushed at the tip from biting. Platform shoes have worn heels and scratches on the belt. Ribbons are black and pink, slightly worn. Shoulder bag is small black faux leather.

[Text Prohibition] No readable text, logos, signs, labels, packages, screen displays, or numbers anywhere on screen. The can is plain. Replace objects that might have text with plain versions.

[Physics/Consistency] Real-world physics. No extra fingers, fused hands, distorted anatomy, floating objects, disappearing items, or sudden deformations. Feet grounded. Ribbons, can, and blouse are the same in all shots.

[Sound] Natural ambient sounds only (switching per shot): silence of the room, sound of the belt at the entrance, leaves in the park, sound of the river, clock in the room, cars under the footbridge, train running sound. No words at all. Occasional small laughs and breathing from the filmer and subject are allowed. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

[Atmosphere] A record of an ordinary day of a Reiwa-era Jirai-kei girl that makes one think 'there's a girl like this.' Not acting, but fragments caught by chance. Cute, a bit lonely, and deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.

promptText:

A bright and lively Japanese TV variety show studio.
In the center, a bicycle completely fixed with safety equipment for filming.
A male host (Ota), a female announcer, several guests, and a studio audience.
Footage that looks like a real Japanese variety show filmed with multiple TV cameras.

The project is a comical fictional challenge: "Pedal a bicycle vigorously by yourself and clear it if you can stop the rotating rear wheel with your buttocks."
Do not perform dangerous physical contact; establish it through safe filming gimmicks, acting, camera angles, sound effects, and editing.
Do not show the contact point itself in close-up.

Yumi: "I'm going to pedal with all my might and stop the tire with my butt!"
SE: Don!

Laughter from the studio.

Telop: <<Clear with a complete stop!>>
Yumi: "Here I go!!"

[0:04–0:07 | Pedaling: 3 seconds]

SE: "Squeak squeak squeak...!"
The rear wheel rotates faster.
Ota: "More! More!"
Guest: "You can go more!"
Yumi pedals more joyfully. Short insert of the rotating rear wheel at the end.

[0:07–0:11 | Challenge Preparation: 4 seconds]
CAM4: Side view, full body. Yumi gets off the bicycle. She looks back at the rotating rear wheel.
CAM2: Face close-up. A momentary tense expression.
CAM4: Side view, full body. Yumi gets into position with her back to the rear wheel.
CAM2: Front medium shot. Yumi says energetically, "I'm going to stop it!!"
Laughter from the studio. Yumi braces herself.

[0:11–0:16 | Challenge: 5 seconds]

CAM4: Immediate cut to side full body. Yumi challenges vigorously. No close-up of contact.
Next moment—
SE: "Screech!!"

Yumi: "Iiiiiitttt huuuuurrrts!!"
CAM4: Immediate full body. She leans her body back significantly in surprise and pain. With that momentum, she jumps up high with a "twitch!"
Guest: "Whoa!!"
Yumi lands: "Ouch, ouch, ouch!!"
She groans and reflexively holds her buttocks with both hands. She loses her balance and falls to the floor. The camera tilts down smoothly following Yumi. She lies on her back in a star shape. The rear wheel is still rotating.

[0:16–0:17 | Failure Judgment: 1 second]
SE: "Buzzzzzzz!!"
CAM7: Diagonally from above, wide shot. Yumi groaning in a star shape on the floor with the bicycle behind her.
Giant telop filling the screen: <<Challenge Failed!!>>
Ota: "Too bad!!"
Studio bursts into laughter.

[0:17–0:27 | 10-Second Slow Motion Replay]
Grand Japanese TV-style BGM. Telop: <<The shocking moment once more—>>

REPLAY CAM: Side view, full body. No zoom on the contact part. Yumi's face and full-body reaction are the main focus.
Her confident expression right before the challenge. The next moment, her expression suddenly changes. Eyes wide, face contorted. The actual scream recorded at normal speed is time-stretched with the video.
Yumi (slowed audio): "Iiiiiiiiiiiiittttt huuuuuuuuuuuurrrrrrttttttsssssss!!"
Her body slowly leans back significantly. Then the whole body jumps up high with a "twi-i-i-itch!"

SE: "Dooooon!!"

promptText:

At the end of the platform is a thick light blue humanoid wall moving at a constant speed along a hidden track; in the center of the wall is a 'crab squat' humanoid hole with the head centered, elbows opened horizontally, hands holding the head, and legs wide apart. Opposite the pool is a semi-circular grandstand filled with spectators, covered by a large white sunshade.

[Character Card]

Character Goal: Quickly understand the pose of the hole and get the body through before the moving humanoid wall arrives.

Performance Style: Realistic variety show reaction, not intentionally cute, not exaggerated from the first second; all facial expression changes must be triggered by the wall movement, physical contact, and the result of falling into the water.

[00:00-00:02.00] Shot 1: Level 2 Start (Close-up Hook)
Front close-up: Xia Yan stands in the center of the orange platform, with the pool and light blue humanoid wall behind her. The lens uses a medium-telephoto focal length to compress the background, with the audience seats slightly blurred.

[00:00-00:00.80]
Xia Yan looks directly at the camera, maintaining a confident and calm smile, shoulders naturally relaxed. The sound of a mechanical device starting and a low motor sound come from the background.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'Level 2, Start!'
Voiceover is bright and energetic, like a live variety show host, not a news anchor tone.

[00:00-00:00.80-00:02.00]
The mechanical operation sound gradually approaches. Xia Yan's smile stops, her eyes suddenly widen, and her lips naturally form a small circle; she looks at the camera first, then quickly turns her eyes to observe the challenge wall behind her.
Reactions cannot appear in advance; they must transition from confidence to surprise after the mechanical sound starts.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'This time it's—the Super Crab Squat!'
'Super Crab Squat' increases in volume and elongates the ending, accompanied by a short variety show brass sound effect.

[00:02.00-00:05.00] Shot 2: Understanding the pose, getting in position (Wide Shot → Rear Three-quarter)
Hard cut to wide shot: Fully displays the orange platform, pool, light blue humanoid wall, and audience seats. The humanoid wall moves at a constant speed from the far end of the platform toward Xia Yan. It stays vertical throughout, with stable speed.

[00:02.00-00:03.00]
Xia Yan quickly turns around to face the humanoid hole, first scanning the outline from top to bottom to confirm the positions of the head, elbows, torso, and legs.
She jogs a few steps toward the positioning area in front of the wall panel, feet making realistic contact with the platform without sliding or teleporting.

[00:03.00-00:05.00]
Rear three-quarter angle: Xia Yan raises her hands behind her head, fingers interlaced, elbows open to the left and right; feet quickly spread to both sides, knees out, center of gravity gradually sinking.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'Legs open, lower the center of gravity, hands behind the head!'
Voiceover rhythm is synchronized with the action: 'Legs open' corresponds to feet moving to both sides; 'lower the center of gravity' corresponds to the body entering a deep squat; 'hands behind the head' corresponds to the hands interlacing behind the head. Actions must be completed sequentially; all three actions appearing in the same frame is prohibited.

[00:05.00-00:09.00] Shot 3: Right pose, wrong size (Symmetrical Front Shot)
Cut to a symmetrical wide shot from the front of the wall panel. The camera films Xia Yan through the humanoid hole, with her head, arms, torso, and legs aligned with the corresponding openings.

[00:05.00-00:06.20]
Xia Yan maintains her hands behind her head and a wide deep squat, adjusting her steps left and right, then moving her body a few centimeters toward the center of the hole. She first looks down to check her foot position, then looks up at the approaching wall. Her lips are slightly pressed together, breathing quickens.

[00:06.20-00:07.50]
The wall panel continues to move forward at a constant speed. Xia Yan presses her center of gravity even lower, making her elbows and legs fit the edges of the hole as closely as possible. She briefly closes her eyes with effort, shoulders slightly raised; when she reopens her eyes, her pupils are dilated, lips open, realizing the hole is tighter than expected.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'The pose is very standard—'
The first half of the sentence sounds excited, as if announcing her imminent success.

[00:07.50-00:09.00]
The wall panel gets closer and closer. She maintains her pose, not daring to move, only slightly rolling her eyes to observe the edges of the hole on both sides. The edges of the hole gradually approach her elbows and legs but have not yet made contact. The confidence on her face slowly disappears, her mouth slightly ajar, breathing pauses for a half-beat.
[Chinese Male Voiceover] 'But this hole... seems a bit small!'
A pause of about 0.3 seconds after 'But this hole'; 'a bit small' lowers in volume, with a clear sense of looming trouble. The background music pauses for a heavy beat here, leaving only the wall's mechanical sound and the audience's gasps.

[00:09.00-00:10.50] Shot 4: Failed to pass through (Side Shot / Physical Comedy)

title: Hand-Drawn 2D Japanese Cooking Animation
description: This highly detailed prompt creates a 15-second anime-style cooking sequence focusing on the process of making cocoa chocolate bread. It uses specific instructions for pencil outlines, cel shading, and precise camera movements to achieve a handcrafted aesthetic.
promptText:
15 seconds, 16:9, text-to-video only. Exactly 6 scenes, 2.5 seconds per scene. All transitions are clean hard cuts with no effects. 0 reference images, start frames, or storyboards. Includes generated natural sounds.

[Art Style]
Original Japanese hand-drawn 2D cooking animation. Completely hand-drawn look. Leaves smooth and clear pencil outlines with subtle line thickness variations and hand-drawn tremors. Thin, warm lines for food; slightly thicker lines for hands and tools. Clean 2-3 level full-color cel shading in warm neutral tones, no crushed black shadows. Kitchen setting with visible brush strokes, shallow atmospheric perspective, restrained analog film grain, and slight color bleeding at cel edges. Strong specular highlights only on ganache and wet dough. Does not imitate existing studios, artists, movies, or characters.

[Subject and Rules]
Subject: Cocoa chocolate bread. Creating a cold ganache sheet with dark chocolate and cream, kneading cocoa dough, and proceeding to primary fermentation. Only an experienced adult woman's hands and forearms are visible. Ivory linen sleeves, warm peach-beige skin, short unpainted nails, five fingers on each hand, no accessories. No face, head, torso, full body, or second person. Subject is only food and cooking process. Each scene has exactly one primary action, and ingredient states only progress forward. Never show finished bread, baked bread, shaped logs, or internal chocolate.

[Scene Composition]
Scene 1 (0.00–2.50) - Camera: High angle close-up looking vertically at a worn oak cutting board, very slow approach. Start: One block of dark couverture and one knife with a pale oak handle. Action: Left hand holds while right hand cuts four separate times, lifting the blade completely each time. Change: A pile of small, even pieces. Texture: Dry, sharp cut surfaces and small crumbs, not melting or shiny. Connection: All pieces go into Scene 2.

Scene 2 (2.50–5.00) *Texture Highlight - Camera: Low side macro just above bowl rim, moving very slowly right. Start: Pieces from Scene 1 melt from the edges in hot cream. Action: Dark brown silicone spatula stirs in three widening circles from center. Change: Pieces disappear into uniform black ganache, last trail closes slowly. Texture: Heavy viscosity without splashing, narrow bright highlights. Connection: Mix butter and flour into ganache, flatten to 3mm and refrigerate.

Scene 3 (5.00–7.50) - Camera: Fixed high 45-degree medium looking down at workbench. Start: One 22x8cm, 3mm thick refrigerated ganache sheet on parchment paper. Action: Two hands grab ends of paper and lift once. Change: Sheet curves gently without sagging or breaking. Texture: Cold, flexible solid, narrow hard luster. Connection: Keep one sheet cold.

Scene 4 (7.50–10.00) - Camera: Fixed high angle close-up near stainless bowl opening. Start: Uniform brown dry powder and cold dairy mixture in center. Action: Spatula folds four times from bottom up. Change: A rough, torn shaggy cocoa dough mass with minimal loose flour. Texture: Dark wet areas, bumpy surface, small dry flour bits at edges. Connection: Dough and one block of butter go to Scene 5.

Scene 5 (10.00–12.50) *Texture Highlight - Camera: Fixed low side medium at workbench height. Start: Butter block in center of shaggy dough. Action: Two hands push forward and fold inward three times. Change: Butter streaks and cracks disappear into smooth, elastic dark cocoa dough; one thin edge passes light without tearing. Texture: Elastic glow instead of wet shine, gluten resistance. Connection: Ferment dough in bowl to approx twice its size.

Scene 6 (12.50–15.00) - Camera: High 45-degree macro toward bowl center, very slow approach to finger mark. Start: Smooth dome of same dough risen to approx double size. Action: One index finger presses center and pulls out completely. Change: Edges return slowly, center mark remains shallow. Texture: Fine fermentation bubbles, soft elasticity, no baked crust. Connection: Ends at this completed fermentation state.

[Camera]
Change at least two of distance, angle, or height per scene. Fixed or extremely slow movement within scenes only. No whip pans, camera shake, rotation, or rapid zoom. Contact points must always be readable. Macro shots used only for Scene 2 and Scene 6.

[Texture and Motion]
Progressive changes: chocolate pieces -> heavy emulsion -> cold flexible sheet; dry powder -> shaggy dough -> smooth gluten -> risen dough. Hands have weight and follow-through; liquids and dough follow viscosity, elasticity, and gravity. No sudden morphing or state regression.

[Lighting and Setting]
Clean, warm morning kitchen. White quartz workbench and worn oak cutting board. Soft gold key light from top-left window, weak cool fill on opposite side, ground shadows in same direction under all objects. Only named objects for the current scene are visible.

[Physical Continuity]
Maintain same couverture amount, ganache batch, cocoa dough mass, hands, sleeves, bowl, kitchen, and light source. Consistent tool/material counts, sizes, and textures. Follow real cooking order and gravity.

[Sound]
Low kitchen room tone and contact sounds only: dry cutting, wet spatula friction, rustling parchment, bowl ringing, dough stickiness. No BGM, dialogue, narration, or voices.

[Negative]
Text, titles, captions, subtitles, numbers, labels, logos,

title: Istanbul Photographer Lifestyle Vlog
description: A multi-shot Seedance 2.5 prompt using reference images to create a photorealistic vlog of a photographer in historic Istanbul.
promptText: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic professional photographer lifestyle vlog. STORY: A female professional photographer prepares her camera equipment at home, travels to historic Istanbul, photographs a female model in the historic streets, reviews the photos on her camera, and finishes by walking through the beautiful historic district. REFERENCE PRIORITY: @IMG1 = MAIN FEMALE PHOTOGRAPHER @IMG2 = ISTANBUL HISTORIC LOCATION @IMG3 = PROFESSIONAL CAMERA GEAR @IMG4 = PHOTOGRAPHER + MODEL PHOTOSHOOT @IMG5 = PHOTO REVIEW @IMG6 = FINAL ISTANBUL WALK CHARACTER CONSISTENCY: The EXACT SAME woman from @IMG1 must appear throughout the video. Preserve her exact: face, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, age appearance and overall identity. She remains the photographer throughout. Keep her outfit, camera bag and professional appearance consistent. -------------------------------------------------- 0–4 SECONDS — PREPARING AT HOME Use @IMG1 + @IMG3. Early morning. The photographer is at home preparing for the photoshoot. She opens her camera bag. She checks the professional camera. She checks the battery and memory card. She carefully attaches the same 24–70mm lens shown in @IMG3. She places the camera into her shoulder bag. She picks up the bag and prepares to leave. CAMERA: Quick cinematic close-ups of the camera, lens and accessories. Then a medium shot of her leaving home. Keep the sequence natural and efficient. -------------------------------------------------- 4–8 SECONDS — ARRIVING IN ISTANBUL Use @IMG1 + @IMG2. Transition naturally to historic Istanbul. The photographer arrives at the Sultanahmet historic area. She walks along the cobblestone street carrying her camera bag. She looks around at the architecture. She chooses a beautiful location for the photoshoot. She takes the camera out of her bag. CAMERA: Wide establishing shot revealing the historic Istanbul architecture. Then a medium tracking shot following the photographer. -------------------------------------------------- 8–13 SECONDS — PREPARING THE PHOTOSHOOT Use @IMG1 + @IMG2 + @IMG3 + @IMG4. The female model arrives. The photographer positions the model against the historic Istanbul architecture. She checks the camera settings. She adjusts the lens. She raises the camera to her eye. She gives the model a subtle hand gesture indicating where to stand and how to pose. The model responds naturally. CAMERA: Medium shot showing photographer and model. Brief close-up of the camera and lens. -------------------------------------------------- 13–20 SECONDS — PROFESSIONAL PHOTOSHOOT Use @IMG4. The photographer begins taking professional photographs. The model poses naturally. The photographer moves slightly to one side to change the composition. She takes a portrait shot. Then she changes position and takes a wider environmental shot. Then she briefly crouches to capture a dramatic low-angle photograph. The model remains natural and confident. The photographer presses the shutter naturally. CAMERA: Alternate between: photographer POV, side angle, over-the-shoulder camera shot, low-angle photography position, wide shot showing the historic architecture. Keep the photography process realistic. -------------------------------------------------- 20–25 SECONDS — REVIEWING THE PHOTOS Use @IMG5. The photoshoot is complete. The photographer lowers the camera. She turns the camera screen toward herself. She scrolls through the photographs. Show a beautiful portrait of the same model on the camera display. She stops on one particularly strong image. She looks pleased with the result. A subtle satisfied smile appears. CAMERA: Medium shot → close-up of camera screen → close-up of photographer's satisfied expression. Make the camera screen look realistic. -------------------------------------------------- 25–30 SECONDS — FINAL WALK AWAY Use @IMG6. The photographer puts the camera on her shoulder. She adjusts the camera strap. She picks up her camera bag. She begins walking calmly through the historic Istanbul street. Warm golden-hour sunlight illuminates the buildings. She walks away from the camera. The camera slowly pulls back into a wide cinematic shot. Reveal the historic street, architecture, domes and distant minarets. End with the photographer becoming smaller in the beautiful Istanbul environment. CUT TO BLACK. -------------------------------------------------- CAMERA STYLE: Premium cinematic travel-fashion photography vlog. Smooth tracking shots. Natural handheld movement. Professional documentary-style camera work. Wide establishing shots. Medium lifestyle shots. Close-ups for camera equipment. Over-the-shoulder photography shots. Gentle cinematic pull-back at the ending. Do not use excessive camera shake. Do not use unrealistic camera movements. -------------------------------------------------- REALISM: Realistic camera handling. Realistic lens interaction. Realistic shutter operation. Realistic walking. Realistic model posing. Natural human anatomy. Realistic hands and fingers. Natural facial expressions. Realistic clothing movement. Realistic camera screen. Natural Istanbul environment. -------------------------------------------------- CONTINUITY: Same female photographer throughout. Same face. Same hairstyle. Same outfit. Same camera. Same lens. Same camera bag. Same Istanbul location. Same model during all photoshoot scenes. No identity swapping. No different photographer. No different model. No camera change. No lens suddenly changing. No face morphing. No distorted hands. No extra fingers. No cartoon. No anime. No CGI-looking people. No text. No logos. No watermark. FINAL FEELING: A polished professional photography lifestyle vlog. The viewer should feel they followed the photographer through a real working day: PREPARE CAMERA → LEAVE HOME → ARRIVE IN ISTANBUL → SET UP SHOOT → PHOTOGRAPH MODEL → REVIEW PHOTOS → WALK AWAY.

title: Realistic Japanese High School Vlog
description: A highly detailed, long-form prompt for generating a realistic 30-second vlog-style video of a Japanese high school student's after-school activities with a nostalgic, home-movie aesthetic.
promptText:
Create a 30-second personal home video in the style of a vlog, filmed by a high school classmate walking home with a Japanese high school girl. Hyper-realistic. The 30 seconds should consist of a montage of hard cuts comprising about 12 short shots (2-3 seconds each). Each shot should be in a different place and at a different moment, where 1 shot = 1 small event. Do not use transition effects or fades. Since the person filming is a close classmate, she is completely relaxed, smiling at the camera, showing things, and talking (words are inaudible). Not poses or acting, but the natural expressions she only shows to friends.

Main Subject:
The same Japanese high school girl throughout all shots. Natural, healthy, realistic skin texture, no makeup, slightly tired but bright eyes after club activities. Black hair tied in a high ponytail with a few stray hairs on her cheeks. White short-sleeved sailor uniform (navy collar and scarf), knee-length navy pleated skirt, white socks, white sneakers, and a shoulder school bag. Keep face, body shape, hairstyle, uniform, and belongings completely consistent from start to finish.

Locations:
A school road and its slopes from after school in summer until sunset. After-school classrooms, hallways, entrance halls, school gates, vending machines, riverbank paths, candy stores, and crosswalks at sunset. Authentic school roads full of everyday life. No crowds, advertisements, or recognizable brands.

Camera / Visual Style:
Common to all shots: a handheld old consumer digital camera held by a classmate. Natural shake, imperfect framing, occasional autofocus changes, exposure fluctuations, soft image detail, light motion blur, subtle digital noise, slightly suppressed colors, and imperfect white balance. No stabilization, gimbals, drones, slow motion, cinematic lighting, or commercial color grading.

Shot List (in order, 2-3 seconds each, all hard cuts):
1. Getting ready to go home in the after-school classroom. Noticing the camera, smiling, and lightly covering the lens with her palm.
2. Walking together down an empty hallway after school. The sound of indoor shoes echoes.
3. Changing into sneakers at the entrance while talking and laughing about something (inaudible).
4. Leaving the school gate, turning back once to look up at the school building in the evening.
5. Buying two drinks at a vending machine and offering one to the lens.
6. Walking along a riverbank path. Laughing while holding her ponytail fluttering in the wind.
7. Squatting down to reach for a cat on a wall, laughing with her friend as the cat deftly dodges.
8. Splitting a popsicle from a candy store in half and offering one side to the camera.
9. A sudden summer shower. Running while laughing with her school bag over her head, then stopping to hold it up halfway.
10. Under a roof with wet bangs, intentionally making a funny face to make the photographer laugh.
11. Turning back while crossing a crosswalk at sunset.
12. Waving both hands widely at a fork in the road. In the middle of this, around 00:29, the recording suddenly cuts to black. No fade-out.

Physical Realism:
Maintain plausible real-world physics in all shots. Hands, fingers, feet, uniform, hair, rain, school bags, and popsicles behave naturally. No extra fingers, fused hands, duplicated limbs, distorted anatomy, floating objects, disappearing items, or sudden deformations. Feet remain properly connected to the ground. Maintain subject consistency between shots, with lighting naturally progressing from after-school to sunset.

Audio:
Natural environmental sounds only. Environmental sounds also cut with each shot. Distant club activity shouts, indoor shoe sounds, cicada chirps, vending machine sounds, popsicle splitting sounds, rain sounds, crosswalk sounds, and inaudible voices and laughter. No music. No narration. No artificial sound effects.

Final Atmosphere:
A video that feels emotional when looked back on, even though it's just 12 ordinary moments lined up. Not a commercial work. Not a fashion film. Not a music video. A record of an ordinary but irreplaceable after-school moment left on a classmate's camera. Carefree, in the middle of youth, nostalgic, warm, spontaneous, and deeply human. Prioritize the feeling that the camera just happened to be there.
